title: Businessfinder input
description: Find contactable businesses with a specific website, local SEO, or reputation opportunity. Results include evidence, lead scoring, and CRM-ready fields.

searchTerms.title: Business types
searchTerms.description: Use distinct business types, for example accountants and commercial cleaners.

location.title: Location
location.description: A town, city, county, or country. Keep the business type out of this field.

maxResultsPerSearch.title: Maximum places per search term
maxResultsPerSearch.description: A hard cost and runtime limit for every search term.

minimumReviews.title: Minimum review count
minimumReviews.description: Exclude businesses with fewer Google reviews than this number.

servicePreset.title: Service opportunity to find
servicePreset.description: Select the problem you sell a solution for. Businessfinder will explain the evidence behind every opportunity.

minimumLeadScore.title: Minimum qualified-lead score
minimumLeadScore.description: Only leads meeting this combined contactability and opportunity score are returned by default.

contactRequirement.title: Required contact method
contactRequirement.description: Choose the minimum contact information a qualified lead must contain.

onlyNewBusinesses.title: Return only new businesses
onlyNewBusinesses.description: Remember qualified businesses for this search and omit them from later scheduled runs.

includeUnqualified.title: Include unqualified candidates
includeUnqualified.description: Diagnostic option. Leave off for a clean list containing only qualified opportunities.

enrichment.title: Contact refinement
enrichment.description: Only public business contact pages are read. Personal employee lead enrichment is not requested.

outreach.title: Outreach
outreach.description: Off by default. Prepare creates drafts in the dataset. Send also requires mailbox secrets and an explicit lawful-basis confirmation.
